value: In FTD, impaired naming correlated with atrophy of the bilateral ventral and anterior temporal regions. The correlation for naming also was more robust in the right anterior temporal cortex in FTD compared with AD, and extended into the bilateral frontal regions. The left posterolateral temporal and right anterior temporal regions were inferred to play a role in the semantic component of the naming deficit in FTD.

spans.text: In FTD, impaired naming correlated with atrophy of the bilateral ventral and anterior temporal regions. The temporal distribution of atrophy and correlation for naming in FTD overlaps in part with that seen in AD in anterior portions of the left temporal lobe. However, the naming-atrophy correlation also was more robust in the right anterior temporal cortex in FTD compared with AD. We also found that the correlation for naming extends into the bilateral frontal regions in FTD.
